newsitem.title: USA: LG&E sees accounting change accretive to Q4.
newsitem.headline: LG&E sees accounting change accretive to Q4.

text.p: LG&E Energy Corp said on Monday that a previously announced change to the mark-to-market accounting method would add about $12 million to $13 million to its fourth quarter earnings.
The method would allow the company to assign a present value to long-term deals, LG&E said.

It said this gain would partly offset previously-announced losses at its Canadian natural gas marketing subsidiary, caused by the activities of a "rogue" marketer who made unauthorized and fraudulent transactions.
While the incident would result in a non-recurring loss at the LG&E Natural unit, the company said without the one-time loss, the unit's 1996 earnings would improve significantly from 1995 results.
